title: Off the Beaten Track in Tanzania
excerpt: Remote parks, mountain villages and empty beaches: ideas for travellers who want to discover a less-visited Tanzania.
body:
## Parks

[Katavi](/blog/katavi-national-park-guide/), [Rubondo](/blog/rubondo-island-national-park/), [Kitulo](/blog/kitulo-plateau-flowers/).

## Mountains

[Usambara](/blog/usambara-mountains-lushoto/), [Udzungwa](/blog/udzungwa-mountains-hiking/), [Mufindi](/blog/mufindi-highlands/).

## History

[Kilwa Kisiwani](/blog/kilwa-kisiwani-ruins/), [Bagamoyo](/blog/bagamoyo-history/).

## Coast

[Pangani and Ushongo](/blog/tanzania-coast-beyond-zanzibar/), [Mafia](/blog/mafia-island-whale-sharks/).

## Highlands

[Empakaai](/blog/ngorongoro-highlands-empakaai/), [Lake Natron](/blog/lake-natron-guide/).

## Planning

These places need more time and planning. Our partner knows the routes.

[Plan your adventure](/travel-proposal/).
